recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Revisit only if current profile generation regresses for active StructureDefinition pages, or if a separate QI-Core IG reconciliation is opened in that external IG context.
issue_request: FHIR-7474 was Published/Persuasive for DSTU1 and asked that profile pages, using the 2015May QI-Core Patient profile page as the example, provide XML and JSON views instead of leaving those tabs empty.
initial_application: The Jira comment says "svn revision 10941", but the converted Git commit at build@10941 is an unrelated Task spreadsheet change. No Git commit explicitly names FHIR-7474. Historical QI-Core profile template commit 1d55c374 nevertheless shows XML and JSON links/tabs were present before the old QI-Core tree was retired.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists active core profile inputs and source/igs.xml has QICore only as a commented-out IG entry. The old guides/qicore2 tree was removed in 2018 and there are no current tracked guides/qicore2 files. Remaining patient-qicore-qicore-patient strings are QUICK model-info identifiers, not current Patient profile pages.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. No source change is needed because tools/templates/template-profile.html already renders XML Template and JSON Template tabs and alternate XML/JSON master definition links for active profile pages, while the specific QI-Core page from the issue is outside current core build scope.
